notes.title: Bathtime Toys DEMO NOW
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/b9b0ab4d248bcb5fd7f6d33c5b1010a9fc159eca.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone,

[h3]Bathtime Toys DEMO is OUT![/h3]
It's a creative playground for kids, where you assemble simple, but cute 3d puzzle toys to play with. Express yourself by coloring them, and decorate your bathtub. No hard rules to win or lose.

Grab the [b]FREE DEMO NOW[/b], and try it until the end of the Steam Next Fest, on 28 February.

[h3]Welcome to Steam Next Fest![/h3]
On [b]22 February 20:00 (UTC+2)[/b] we're playing Bathtime Toys live, so join us, and see what the kids are up to this time! We're gonna build some toys, decorate the bathtub, and invent some funny challenges.

[h3]THE FULL GAME[/h3]
If you feel inspired, [b]WISHLIST [/b]the game, and be ready for the [b]FULL RELEASE on 3 March[/b]!
It will also be available on Google Play for Android phones and tablets.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41592613/969fde23dc61f9aaabb529d3405b2a464eb654cd.jpg[/img]

For more info, join Last Tales Discord server:
https://discord.gg/gdUbBhj

Have fun!
Alex
